purpose: Teach: 人様/見合っ/ヶ国/すぐさま/助長/覆っ/ほかなら/乗せる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、人様にお声を掛けて下さるご親切な方ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was so kind — reaching out to people like that.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost thinking aloud. Gentle pride in noticing something good. Slow, thoughtful pace. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、隣の方と席を見合って譲り合われたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you see how they gave up their seat to the person next to them?
lines.style: Quiet delight. Speaking to Aoi like sharing a secret. Soft, genuine smile audible in the voice. No performance — just noticing together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、十数ヶ国を回ってこられた旅人だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they told me they've been traveling across a dozen countries.
lines.style: Thoughtful wonder. Drawing out the scale of it. Reflective tempo, like the distance is right there in her voice. Trailing slightly into the idea.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、クレームにはすぐさま対応しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when complaints do come, respond right away — don't let them sit.
lines.style: Steady, direct guidance. Not harsh, but matter-of-fact. The tone of someone who knows from experience. Brief pause before the instruction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、過剰なサービスは依存を助長するから注意ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, but be careful — too much service can make people dependent on you.
lines.style: Gentle caution. Slight hesitation, like weighing the kindness against the consequence. Softer on the warning. Caring correction, not criticism.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お皿を布で覆ってお席に運ぼうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, try covering the plate with a cloth before you bring it out.
lines.style: Simple, practical suggestion. Warm tone but efficiency underneath. Light, like passing on a small trick. No fuss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の魅力はほかならぬスタッフの笑顔ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, what makes this place special is you — your smile, when you mean it.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No softening. Slight emphasis on 'you.' Quiet conviction underneath. Looking at her while saying it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにお客様の心を乗せるよう工夫しよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, put your heart into the new menu — let customers feel that in what you're offering.
lines.style: Encouraging, not demanding. Warmth with intention. A little slower on 'heart.' Leaning into the possibility. Open-ended, hopeful close.
